name: CMIS Base Industry Specification
description: Universal rules and semantic ontology for Common Management Interface Specification (CMIS 3.0/4.0/5.x) and SFF-8636 optical transceivers.

readonly_ranges.desc: Identifier, Status, Latched Flags, DDM Telemetry Monitors

readonly_pages.desc: Base Information / Factory EEPROM / Vendor ID

clear_on_read_and_interrupt.description: CMIS 3.0/4.0/5.x and SFF-8636 Latched Flag registers, Clear-on-Read (COR) semantics, and Interrupt (IntL) handling.

latched_flag_registers.desc: Module-Level Latched Alarms and Warnings (Temp, Vcc, Aux)
Lane-Level Latched Flags (Tx/Rx LOS, LOL, Fault, Bias AW, Tx/Rx Power AW)

page00_and_readonly_guard.description: Page 00h factory EEPROM and Lower Page 0~25 protection and checksum integrity.

unlocked_write_protection.rule: Writes to Page 00h must be gated by vendor/user password unlock check (e.g. Psw_Mod > PSW_MOD_USR1).

paging_and_bounds.description: Lower Page byte 127 Page Select handling and Upper Page pointer dereference bounds defense.

laser_safety_and_tx_disable.description: Laser safety interlocks, Tx_Disable active-high polarity, and hardware fault fast squelch.

register_polarity.desc: CMIS Tx_Disable registers are Active-High (1 = Disabled/Off, 0 = Enabled/On).

module_and_datapath_state_machine.description: Section 5 Module and Datapath state transitions and LowPwr dual-mode evaluation.

module_low_power_rule.desc: Low power mode must evaluate both the physical LPMode pin and the CMIS LowPwr software register.

cdb_firmware_upgrade.description: Command Data Block (CDB) execution state machine and status synchronicity.

transceiver_production_robustness.description: Mass-production optical transceiver architectural robustness and hardware safety rules derived from field-proven transceivers.

i2c_busy_guard.description: Shared MSA shadow register updates and interrupt assertions in background loop must be synchronized with wait_i2c_busy() to prevent torn reads.

flash_i2c_isolation.description: Flash sector erase and word programming must isolate/disable I2C slave peripheral to prevent fatal clock-stretching and bus lockups.

pid_output_clamping.description: Closed-loop TEC and bias PID algorithms must enforce both incremental step limiting (anti-windup) and DAC output saturation clamping.

calibration_saturation.description: Fixed-point ADC slope calibration multiplication must promote 16-bit operands to 32-bit and clamp results to prevent sign inversion wrapping.

lut_hysteresis.description: Dynamic temperature lookup table (LUT) compensation must feature input clamping and hysteresis deadband filtering to prevent DAC hunting.

boot_jump_dual_lock.description: Bootloader / IAP execution jump must require dual independent interlocks (password state AND magic key) to prevent accidental link drops.
